# Required Outputs

Per these guidelines, the following represent the outputs expected for the Housing Growth Plan report and Regional Housing Needs allocation. The approach used to generate these outputs is at the discretion of the COG or municipality; sections [3](stat_def.qmd) and [4](vac_redev.qmd) suggest a framework along with supporting data and resources for doing so.

<br>

## Housing growth plans

C.G.S. Sections 8-13bb(d) and (i), and 8-13cc(b) require OPM to issue guidelines on the “form and level of detail” required of Housing Growth Plans (HGPs) as well as the formats, mapping standards and standardized metrics for annual reporting on HGP implementation. The Secretary may amend these guidelines from time to time. These [Housing Growth Plan Guidelines](https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/057c27cda2d848edbcb1ffac4a1b8898/page/Housing-Growth-Plans-Page) can be viewed on the [2025 Act Concerning Housing Growth web page](https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/057c27cda2d848edbcb1ffac4a1b8898/page/Homepage) from OPM.

Per the Housing Growth Plan Guidelines, the following outputs are should be included in the Housing Growth Plan report as part of the developable land inventory:

1.  Three town-wide maps produced in accordance with the mapping standards outlined in [Section 5: Creating the Maps](map.qmd), illustrating (1) statutory exclusions, (2) developable land, (3) a developable land summary, including vacant parcels and areas with redevelopment potential.

2.  Narrative description of the methodology used to develop the inventory of developable land. This should include how vacant and potential redevelopment areas were identified, a summary of data sources used, how datasets were queried and processed, and the methods used to classify land.

<br>

## Regional housing needs program

[C.G.S. Sec. 8-13dd]{.underline}: The results of this process of identifying qualifying developable land per C.G.S. Section 8-13aa are used in calculating the Regional Housing Needs allocation under C.G.S. Section 8-13dd(c)(3).
